metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Taiwan increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (tropospheric nitrogen dioxide) - Date Range 1: February 10-25, 2020 - Date Range 2: April 20-May 12, 2020 - Location: Taiwan (approximately 120-122°E, 22-25°N) - The question asks about a change between two periods, so I need to calculate the mean NO2 for each period and compare them. 2. Masking Strategy: - Sentinel-5P provides quality-filtered data. I should use the QA value filter to exclude poor quality pixels. - No cloud masking needed as this is atmospheric data from TROPOMI sensor. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid vs. Error: - Valid Zero (A/B): Both periods have valid data and pixel counts > 0. Compare means to answer if increase occurred. - C1: If either period has no data. - C2: If after QA filtering, pixel counts are 0. - C3: If mean values are None, NaN, or out of valid range (NO2 should be 0-300 µmol/m²). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Define Taiwan geometry taiwan_coords = [[[120, 22], [122, 22], [122, 25], [120, 25], [120, 22]]] taiwan = ee.Geometry.Polygon(taiwan_coords) # 2. Load Sentinel-5P NO2 data s5p = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2') # 3. Filter for Period 1: Feb 10-25, 2020 period1 = s5p.filterDate('2020-02-10', '2020-02-26').filterBounds(taiwan) print(f"Period 1 (Feb 10-25): {period1.size().getInfo()} images") if period1.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No data for Feb 10-25, 2020") print("C1") else: # Filter by QA value (quality flag) period1_filtered = period1.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75))) # Calculate mean NO2 mean1_result = period1_filtered.select('NO2_tropospheric_column').mean().reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=taiwan, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ) mean1 = mean1_result.get('NO2_tropospheric_column').getInfo() # Check pixel count for period 1 count1 = period1_filtered.select('NO2_tropospheric_column').mean().reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=taiwan, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_tropospheric_column').getInfo() print(f"Period 1: Mean={mean1}, Pixels={int(count1) if count1 else 0}") if count1 == 0: print("No valid pixels in Period 1 after QA filtering") print("C2") elif mean1 is None or (mean1 < 0 or mean1 > 300): print("Invalid NO2 value in Period 1") print("C3") else: # 4. Filter for Period 2: Apr 20 - May 12, 2020 period2 = s5p.filterDate('2020-04-20', '2020-05-13').filterBounds(taiwan) print(f"Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12): {period2.size().getInfo()} images") if period2.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No data for Apr 20-May 12, 2020") print("C1") else: # Filter by QA value period2_filtered = period2.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75))) # Calculate mean NO2 mean2_result = period2_filtered.select('NO2_tropospheric_column').mean().reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=taiwan, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ) mean2 = mean2_result.get('NO2_tropospheric_column').getInfo() # Check pixel count for period 2 count2 = period2_filtered.select('NO2_tropospheric_column').mean().reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=taiwan, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_tropospheric_column').getInfo() print(f"Period 2: Mean={mean2}, Pixels={int(count2) if count2 else 0}") if count2 == 0: print("No valid pixels in Period 2 after QA filtering") print("C2") elif mean2 is None or (mean2 < 0 or mean2 > 300): print("Invalid NO2 value in Period 2") print("C3") else: # 5. Compare means print(f"Comparison: Feb Mean={mean1:.2f}, Apr-May Mean={mean2:.2f}, Change={mean2-mean1:.2f}") if mean2 > mean1: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define Taiwan geometry
taiwan_coords = [[[120, 22], [122, 22], [122, 25], [120, 25], [120, 22]]]
taiwan = ee.Geometry.Polygon(taiwan_coords)

# 2. Load Sentinel-5P NO2 data
s5p = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2')

# 3. Filter for Period 1: Feb 10-25, 2020
period1 = s5p.filterDate('2020-02-10', '2020-02-26').filterBounds(taiwan)
print(f"Period 1 (Feb 10-25): {period1.size().getInfo()} images")

if period1.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No data for Feb 10-25, 2020")
    print("C1")
else:
    # Filter by QA value (quality flag)
    period1_filtered = period1.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75)))
    
    # Calculate mean NO2
    mean1_result = period1_filtered.select('NO2_tropospheric_column').mean().reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=taiwan,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    mean1 = mean1_result.get('NO2_tropospheric_column').getInfo()
    
    # Check pixel count for period 1
    count1 = period1_filtered.select('NO2_tropospheric_column').mean().reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=taiwan,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NO2_tropospheric_column').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Period 1: Mean={mean1}, Pixels={int(count1) if count1 else 0}")
    
    if count1 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels in Period 1 after QA filtering")
        print("C2")
    elif mean1 is None or (mean1 < 0 or mean1 > 300):
        print("Invalid NO2 value in Period 1")
        print("C3")
    else:
        # 4. Filter for Period 2: Apr 20 - May 12, 2020
        period2 = s5p.filterDate('2020-04-20', '2020-05-13').filterBounds(taiwan)
        print(f"Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12): {period2.size().getInfo()} images")
        
        if period2.size().getInfo() == 0:
            print("No data for Apr 20-May 12, 2020")
            print("C1")
        else:
            # Filter by QA value
            period2_filtered = period2.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75)))
            
            # Calculate mean NO2
            mean2_result = period2_filtered.select('NO2_tropospheric_column').mean().reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                geometry=taiwan,
                scale=3000,
                maxPixels=1e9
            )
            mean2 = mean2_result.get('NO2_tropospheric_column').getInfo()
            
            # Check pixel count for period 2
            count2 = period2_filtered.select('NO2_tropospheric_column').mean().reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                geometry=taiwan,
                scale=3000,
                maxPixels=1e9
            ).get('NO2_tropospheric_column').getInfo()
            
            print(f"Period 2: Mean={mean2}, Pixels={int(count2) if count2 else 0}")
            
            if count2 == 0:
                print("No valid pixels in Period 2 after QA filtering")
                print("C2")
            elif mean2 is None or (mean2 < 0 or mean2 > 300):
                print("Invalid NO2 value in Period 2")
                print("C3")
            else:
                # 5. Compare means
                print(f"Comparison: Feb Mean={mean1:.2f}, Apr-May Mean={mean2:.2f}, Change={mean2-mean1:.2f}")
                
                if mean2 > mean1:
                    print("A")
                else:
                    print("B")
